game.name: Medal of Honor : Warfighter (Europe)(En,De,It)(Disc 1)
game.desc: Medal of Honor: Warfighter is a first-person shooter and the sequel to the 2010 reboot of the Medal of Honor series. The single-player game begins with the characters Voodoo, Mother and Preacher - the latter controlled by the player - all returning from the previous game as they embark on a mission in Karachi, Afghanistan. They are members of the U.S. Navy SEALs and what starts out as a simple demolition job goes horribly wrong when the truck containing the explosive substance PETN blows up the docks almost completely. After Dusty's debriefing, also back from the previous game, Voodoo is assigned to Task Force Mako, along with DEVGRU agent Stump, while Mother and Preacher return to the scene to investigate the shipyard incident. Instead of one big battle, the game features missions linked together by the story of the search for the origin of the PETN substance.
